newsitem.title: UK: GAN reorganises London market operations.
newsitem.headline: GAN reorganises London market operations.

text.p: French insurer GAN on Tuesday said it has reorganised its London market property, commercial lines and speciality lines underwriting operations.

The reorganisation would enable GAN to take better advantage of its substantial market presence and offer its brokers a wider range of products and underwriting expertise, commercial lines director Stephen Hartington said in a statement.
"Our mission is to be a major force in commercial business in the UK," he added.

The company's property, European property and engineering units will be merged into a London Market Property Division headed by Patrick Gage. It will target larger risks in the UK and the rest of Europe.
GAN will also operate a commercial lines City branch office from the London Underwriting Centre from April 1. This will be led by Stephen Albutt.
The UK branch network will be reorganised under Maggie Litster, agency and business development manager, with a view to enhancing the company's UK commercial underwriting presence.
The speciality lines division will be expanded to include UK and international excess liability accounts.
